facts.title: Vritti UI
facts.description: Beautifully designed React components built with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4, and Motion animations.

research.name: Vritti UI
research.note: Large shadcn registry of animated components and blocks plus in-browser creative tools such as a Shader Studio and Dither Studio.

effects: Shader Studio: 87 Canvas 2D and WebGL generative shaders (flow field particle trails, topographic contour map, L-system tree) with colour schemes and code export
Dither Studio for SVG dithered backgrounds and Texture Studio with stackable WebGL filters

unverified: No dated changelog or release was found (/changelog and /docs/changelog return 404), so lastUpdated is empty.
No public source repository was found: the author's GitHub account satyajitghana has no Vritti repository and GitHub repository search for vritti returned only unrelated projects.
Pricing is free based on the absence of any pricing page or paid tier; no explicit statement was seen.
Dither Studio and Texture Studio were not opened; they are described on the home page.
